items.title: David Torkanowsky interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, September 26, 2019
items.q: Frank Sinatra, you know some of my favorite singers don’t have very good voices: Frank Sinatra, Tony Bennett.

ctx.x: Know what tune they want to sing. Make it a tune or two or, your first objective is to, after the end of a tune would be asked to sing another. If you’re asked to sit down after the first tune you got to go back to the shed. But first of all pick a tune that plays to the strength of the band. If the band is a swinging band, you know, pick a swing tune and trade with the drummer, you know, really interact. They’re not there to back you up.
